rockawayx.finding: Distinguish USDC Yield from its Confidential RWA and ecosystem vaults. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.

bend.finding: Berachain lists a Re7 BUSD lending vault. Identify the exact vault and BUSD on Berachain; check current caps, terms and locally eligible access.
researchSteps: Conditional route. BEND. The lending interface lists Re7 BUSD on Berachain. Match the BUSD asset and curator. Cost: $0 for review. Time: allow 20 minutes as an estimate.
Before any deposit obtain the current share redemption terms, liquidity, entry and exit quotes, and local access conditions. The lending page alone does not establish these details.
Borrower interest and chain-level emissions are separate from a prospective BEND token. No distribution to this wallet is verified. Leave capital uncommitted until withdrawal terms are known.
